paragraphs: Rav Anan bar Tachlifa: [Pesachim 101a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.101a.4). Rava bar Tachlifa: [Eruvin 40a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.40a.7).

notes.text: The supplied impossible Sanhedrin locator צש: is disclosed and read as 97b in connection with the whole Rav Chanan bar Tachlifa notice numbered972. No native image verification is claimed.

The consulted Eruvin 63a has Abba in the arrival and Acha in the objection. Ketubot calls the final speaker Rabbi Shimon son of Tachlifa. The linked Sanhedrin has Chanan even though the supplied locator has an irregular letter form.
